panels.title: Approval vs. rejection rate
panels.description: The single most important quality signal: a healthy agent should see its acceptance rate stay high and stable over time. A dropping acceptance rate is the earliest warning sign that diagnoses have gotten worse, before anything 'breaks' outright.

panels.title: LLM tokens consumed (cost proxy, by provider)
panels.description: Raw token counts, split prompt vs. completion. Multiply by the provider's published per-token price outside Grafana (left as a recording rule or a per-provider pricing table, not hardcoded here, since prices change and shouldn't require a dashboard edit to update).

panels.title: Proposals executed (by kind)
panels.description: Should always be <= proposals approved -- if this ever exceeds the approved count, something bypassed the governance gate, which would itself be a critical incident.
